definitions.explanation: The area or position closer to the speaker, as opposed to the back or far side.
A point shortly before arriving at a destination.

examples.japanese: {手前|てまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter through the door on this side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手前|てまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a chair in front of the bookshelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目的地|もくてきち}→目的地：09996_mokutekichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手前|てまえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}めた→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped the car just before the destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手前|てまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There's a convenience store just before the intersection, so turn right there.

notes: {手前|てまえ} is the opposite of ⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧ (back/interior). It indicates the side closer to the speaker. When giving directions, [place]の{手前|てまえ} means 'just before [place].' The word can also be used as a humble form of 'I' in very formal situations, but this usage is quite old-fashioned.
